text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both modestly negative over the past day, with Ethereum underperforming Bitcoin by 0.5%, suggesting selective weakness in larger-cap alts. The Fear & Greed Index at 28 reflects genuine market apprehension that has intensified over the past week, though modest gains in mid-cap assets like Solana indicate some traders are still rotating into riskier positions rather than exiting entirely. Bitcoin dominance holding above 59% alongside $82B daily volume points to a consolidation phase—neither capitulation nor conviction, but cautious repositioning.
